# Section 04 Highlights — Commerce Patterns — Savoy House Lighting (shl)
- Run date: 2026-06-17

## Highlight Candidates

1. **eCat already digitizes $3.4M of ordering, concentrated where it earns its keep** — eCat carries $3.4M of Savoy House's order volume over the trailing 12 months, $3.2M of it rep-assisted project orders on iPad. The enablement upside is the rep- and back-office-entered flow (phone and email orders keyed by hand) that eCat and your own web could absorb — not a bigger eCat percentage for its own sake.
   - dollar_figure: $3.4M placed through eCat (trailing 12 months)
   - surprise_score: 4.7
   - signal_id: SIG-COMMERCE-01

These are existing customers whose hand-keyed ordering is the clearest digital-enablement target.

## Priority Action Candidate

- **[GROWTH]** Target the hand-keyed order flow at high-business, low-eCat accounts — Ferguson ($2.7M total, 3.0% through eCat), Shades Of Light ($1.7M, 4.4%), Lighting Incorporated ($259K, 19%) — moving their existing rep/back-office ordering into eCat (or their own web) to cut entry time and errors. Urgency: MEDIUM. Model: Sunbelt / Louisiana at 23.3%.
